name: skyrim
label: Skyrim
description: The menus of a northern fantasy game on a cold Nordic night, walked as an adventurer's journey: light grey-white capitals, thin double-line frames with a diamond at each corner, a compass bar with icons at the top, a compass star for the map, a star-sign helmet and angular runes. The regions go from snowy mountains under an aurora (blue) through a misty rain forest (green) to a burning canyon (red), each with its own color and scenery in plain lines, with a frost between slides.
